title: Show HN: Agentic CUDA Kernel Optimizer
summary: A developer built an AI agent system using LangGraph that can automatically optimize CUDA kernels. The system includes a C++ test harness allowing AI agents to execute kernels, collect benchmarks, and profile performance using NVIDIA Nsight, combining automated optimization with GPU performance analysis.
problem_solved: Automates the tedious process of CUDA kernel optimization by enabling AI agents to iteratively test, benchmark, and improve GPU kernel performance.
why_valuable: It democratizes GPU optimization by letting AI agents handle the trial-and-error process of kernel tuning, potentially finding optimizations humans might miss.
